Business Outlook Q1 2026
•New Asset Acquisition Plans:
-Approved the 5th Additional Investment 
and Capital Increase No. 3 (Unitholder 
Resolution on Jan 9, 2026)
-Asset Value Milestone: Total Asset 
Value projected to exceed Baht 15,000 
Million.
-Long -term Sustainability: Extended 
average Leasehold period to 28 years, 
ensuring stable and long -term 
distributions for unitholders.
-Prime Strategic Locations: Maintaining 
dominance in Thailand’s logistics 
heartland, including Bangna -Trad Road, 
Samut Prakan , and the EEC.
-Acquisition Source: Will the focus be on 
acquiring assets from the Sponsor 
(Prospect Development), and third -party.
Macroeconomic Factors, 
Thailand Industrial Real Estate 
Market Overview and Trends 
•Economic forecast by Bank of Thailand (BOT): 
-Q1 2026 economic growth was driven by tech exports, private 
consumption (EVs/fuel), industrial recovery, and government 
spending, but faced the end of the quarter, the Middle East conflict 
began to impact the economy, leading to a visible decline in 
regional exports and European/Middle Eastern tourist arrivals.
•BOI Investment Summary (Q1 2026):
-BOI applications surged 2.4 -fold YoY to THB 1.01 trillion, driven by 
mega -projects in high -tech industries (digital/electronics) and 
heavily concentrated in the Central and Eastern regions. 
-FDIaccounted for THB 965,869 million, led by Singapore, the UK, 
Japan, China, and Hong Kong. These approved projects are 
projected to heavily boost the economy, generating over 42,000 
jobs, utilizing THB 200 billion in domestic materials, and increasing 
annual exports by over THB 520 billion.
•Industrial real estate sector: 
-SCB EIC expects RBF rental demand to rise by ~60,000 sq.m ., 
driven by smaller -scale investors seeking lower costs and fast 
production. New supply will slow to ~120,000 sq.m . post -2025's 
relocation surge, aligning with plans to fill vacancy gaps. Despite a 
positive investment outlook, global uncertainties and a high -tech 
shift require operators to offer high -quality, stable utilities to stay 
competitive.Investment and 
Growth Strategy
•Occupancy Rate, Renewal Rate, and 
Rental Rate:
-Maintaining high occupancy rates above 
95%, and high renewal rates above 90%. 
-Future rental rate adjustments are 
expected to align with market conditions 
and inflation.
•Revenue Projection:
-Following the 5th Additional Investment, 
which is expected to take place in Q2 –Q3
2026, total revenue for 2026 is projected 
to grow from approximately THB 1,138 
million to THB 1,527 million, based on the 
pro-forma profit and loss statement for 
the period of June 1, 2026 -May 31,
